title: Prime membership in a finite projective module is detected at the prime localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $N$ a finite projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], $s\in N$, and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal. Under the canonical map $N\to N_{\mathfrak p}$ with $N_{\mathfrak p}$ the localization at a prime [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], one has $s/1\in\mathfrak pN_{\mathfrak p}$ if and only if $s\in\mathfrak pN$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective), together with localization and quotient exactness
